attr.title: Tony Hawk's Underground
attr.desc: Neversoft's 2003 skateboarding game, running natively: Story Mode, Free Skate, Create-a-Skater, Create-a-Park and the intro videos.
attr.inst: Requires the USA Xbox version. Copy your disc image (.iso) into ports/thug/gamedata; the first launch extracts it. Made for 640x480 devices with 1 GB of RAM.
